body: Great machine for daily work. Battery backup dropped to around 6 hours during my coding and browser sessions, not the 11.5 hours advertised.
After 14 months of use, the hinge stiffness and creaking began on the right corner. Otherwise performance is rock solid.
I noticed fan noise under dual compiler load when building large projects. It cools down quickly though.
Whisper-quiet dual fan cooling system works well in normal web browsing, completely silent on battery.
Military-grade MIL-STD-810H durability shows in the stiff lid, took multiple backpack trips without scratches.
Battery last only 6 hours with brightness at 75% running VS Code and 20 Chrome tabs.
